title: Tapered Shaft And Four Spoke Basket Ski Pole
description: One newly authored whole fixed ski-pole-inspired decorative display: a long gently tapered circular shaft rises from a finite blunt tip through a wide annular four-spoke basket to a complete swollen palm grip, end cap and rooted oval wrist loop. The basket has four genuine open quadrants around its full central hub; the whole strap is a closed thick loop, not a painted mark. One complete pole, not a paired kit, old tool shaft or extracted fragment. Four opaque constant PBR roles, metres, Z up, centre-of-envelope ground origin. Static upright illustration with a finite tip datum only; no claim that a real pole balances upright without support. No skier, action, manufacturer branding, dimensions for manufacture, shaft flex, strap-release mechanism, snow penetration, load capacity, operating instructions, safety certification or practical sport function.
